document.title: Statement of Work
document.place_of_performance: Services will be performed remotely by United States-based AIS personnel.

background: Contoso Community Health Network needs flexible advisory and engineering capacity as analytics priorities evolve.
objectives: Provide governed access to multidisciplinary analytics expertise.
Maintain transparent prioritization and progress reporting.

in_scope.title: Backlog advisory
in_scope.description: Refine and prioritize approved analytics work items with client leadership.

in_scope.title: Engineering support
in_scope.description: Deliver client-directed analytics engineering within the approved backlog.

out_of_scope.title: Unapproved systems
out_of_scope.description: Work in systems not authorized through the joint backlog is excluded.

deliverables.title: Iteration outcomes
deliverables.description: Completed backlog items and supporting technical notes.
acceptance_criteria: Each item satisfies its client-approved definition of done.

deliverables.title: Capacity report
deliverables.description: Periodic summary of work completed, decisions, risks, and next priorities.
acceptance_criteria: Report is reviewed during the agreed governance meeting.

milestones.title: Service initiation
milestones.description: Backlog governance and access are established.

milestones.title: Service closeout
milestones.description: Final work summary and transition notes are delivered.

ais.title: Managed capacity
ais.description: AIS will staff agreed roles and report progress against client priorities.

client.title: Prioritization
client.description: Client will own backlog priority, decisions, access, and acceptance.

assumptions.title: Work authorization
assumptions.description: Only jointly approved backlog items will enter active delivery.

notes: Rates and estimated investment will be completed through AIS commercial review.
